description: This file contains CUDA kernel helpers and function definitions for performing scan operations such as cumulative max, min, sum, and log-sum-exp on tensors within the PyTorch framework. It includes implementations for manipulating tensors on CUDA devices, kernel dispatch registration, and helper functions.

methods.description: Computes the cumulative maximum along a dimension for a CUDA tensor.

methods.name: void cummin_helper_cuda(const Tensor & self,Tensor & values,Tensor & indices,int64_t dim)
methods.description: Computes the cumulative minimum along a dimension for a CUDA tensor.

methods.name: Tensor & _logcumsumexp_out_cuda(const Tensor & self,int64_t dim,Tensor & result)
methods.description: Computes the log cumulative sum of exponentials for a tensor and writes result to output.

methods.name: Tensor _logcumsumexp_cuda(const Tensor & self,int64_t dim)
methods.description: Creates a new tensor with the log cumulative sum of exponentials.

methods.description: Helper to perform cumulative sum along a dimension.

methods.description: Helper to perform cumulative product along a dimension.
